evidence.dominant_driver: Waltz says Trump remains open to talks but Iran must come to the table, adding a concrete diplomatic option to an ongoing escalation cluster.

market_expectations.expected_value: Diplomatic progress should lower oil/safe-haven premia and support equities; much of that bundle was already visible before the headline.
market_expectations.distribution_notes: No confirmed negotiation or ceasefire; this is an incremental diplomatic signal.

absorption.reason: Before and around the headline oil was already down sharply, US equity futures were higher and gold was lower; the story reinforces rather than creates the prevailing de-escalation/risk-on tape.

observations.interpretation: The broader basket is consistent with easing geopolitical/energy risk, though much of it predates the Waltz headline.

evidence.decision_notes: Residual forecast from 12:15 UTC. Leakage-safe M2 learning: 1h directional confidence 5-6 is ACTIONABLE REDUCE_OR_AVOID; 1h low-confidence MIXED is ACTIONABLE KEEP_NEUTRAL, so the candidate stays MIXED at 1h.

regimes.risk: risk-on; US futures higher before cash open
regimes.energy: oil sharply lower on supply/diplomacy relief
regimes.metals: gold lower; geopolitical premium partly compressed

immediate.rationale: The headline is already about 30 minutes old and gold was already lower before it; residual de-escalation edge is limited.

next_session.rationale: Without confirmed talks or a ceasefire, the geopolitical premium can rebuild quickly.

15m.rationale: The headline is already about 30 minutes old and gold was already lower before it; residual de-escalation edge is limited.

1h.rationale: Talks are only an option, not an agreement; lower yields offset part of the bearish safe-haven effect.

4h.rationale: If the diplomatic opening persists into the US session, some remaining geopolitical premium can bleed from gold.

next_session.rationale: Without confirmed talks or a ceasefire, the geopolitical premium can rebuild quickly.

predictions.mechanism: Diplomatic progress can reduce geopolitical safe-haven demand, but lower Treasury yields support non-yielding gold.
predictions.invalidation: Fresh US/Iran military escalation, rising oil/VIX, or explicit rejection of talks would invalidate the 4h downside view.
predictions.counter_case: Iran may reject the condition or fresh attacks may revive the safe-haven premium faster than diplomacy can compress it.

immediate.rationale: US futures were already higher before the headline, so much of the risk-on impulse was pre-priced.

next_session.rationale: The benefit depends on actual Iran-US diplomatic follow-through and oil staying lower.

15m.rationale: US futures were already higher before the headline, so much of the risk-on impulse was pre-priced.

1h.rationale: Diplomatic language is supportive but not enough to separate from the existing oil/AI-led risk-on move.

4h.rationale: Sustained de-escalation language plus cheaper oil can support broad equities after cash open.

next_session.rationale: The benefit depends on actual Iran-US diplomatic follow-through and oil staying lower.

predictions.mechanism: Lower geopolitical and energy risk reduces inflation/tail-risk pressure and supports broad equity risk appetite.
predictions.invalidation: A renewed oil spike, escalation headline, or reversal in Treasury yields would weaken the 4h upside case.
predictions.counter_case: The market may refocus on restrictive Fed policy and elevated yields once the already-priced diplomacy relief is exhausted.
